This editorial illustration features a red masthead with the word "TEMPO" in a serif typeface and a tagline reading "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." In the upper right, there is a white box with a barcode, QR code, and text including "22-28 NOVEMBER 2021" and "RP 45.000." Smaller headlines appear below: "Kisruh Transaksi Proyek Mobil Listrik H.84" and "Berebut Kursi Ketua Umum NU H.26."

The central image is set against a textured pink background. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a blue shirt and brown bag, holds a grey laptop. She stands in profile, looking toward a large, dark blue silhouette of a person wearing a graduation cap and gown. This silhouette holds a finger to its lips in a "shushing" gesture. Another smaller silhouette of a person's head is visible on the far left. At the bottom, a dark desk surface is visible.

White text on the right reads "Wabah Predator Seks" above a paragraph starting with "Kekerasan seksual di kampus Indonesia..." and ending with "H.66." The overall composition uses dark blue, red, and pink tones.
